title: A Portainer instance answers unauthenticated
summary: The Portainer API returns its status without a sign in.  Portainer controls Docker, so an exposed instance is control of the host.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and body_contains("Version") and body_contains("InstanceID") and body_differs(control)

remediate: Never expose Portainer; require authentication and restrict the network.
